entries.english:
Agreements between the Lords von Rosenberg and the Counts von Hatzfeldt with neighboring lordships, including concerning the jointly held village of Münster; folios 1–258, with an index.

Date range: 1503, 1553–1640.

Contents: Included: (1) fols. 70–73, agreement between Hans von Finsterlohe and Zaisolph von Rosenberg concerning hunting rights (original), 1564; (2) fols. 145–147, agreement between Graf Georg Friedrich von Hohenlohe, Zaisolph von Rosenberg, and Hans Ludwig Lochinger zu Archshofen concerning hunting rights in Münster (original), 1614; (3) fols. 220–227, settlement between Georg Siegmund von Rosenberg and the city of Rothenburg (original), 1603.

Extent: 1 volume, fols. 1–258.
